events.exact_fact_text: 2026-05-11 14:02:00 UTC，资产 `web-app-01`，Public-facing web server received exploit requests against the login endpoint before external TLS traffic began.，源地址 `10.60.1.14`
背景/替代解释事件：2026-05-11 14:04:40 UTC，资产 `web-app-01`，WAF telemetry also showed generic scanner payloads blocked earlier in the same window.，源地址 `10.60.1.14`
2026-05-11 14:07:30 UTC，资产 `web-app-01`，关联对象 `cdn-auth-check.net`，The web server resolved cdn-auth-check.net shortly after the exploit attempts.，源地址 `10.60.1.14`
2026-05-11 14:12:00 UTC，资产 `web-app-01`，关联对象 `cdn-auth-check.net / 198.51.100.88`，Seed JA4 alert matched a possible web-shell beacon over TLS.，源地址 `10.60.1.14`
2026-05-11 14:14:10 UTC，资产 `web-app-01`，关联对象 `cdn-auth-check.net / 198.51.100.88`，The same web server reconnected to the same external infrastructure after the seed alert.，源地址 `10.60.1.14`
2026-05-11 14:16:30 UTC，资产 `web-app-01`，A web-shell file named shell.aspx appeared under /var/www/html/.cache after the exploit traffic.，源地址 `10.60.1.14`
2026-05-11 14:18:10 UTC，资产 `web-app-01`，PowerShell launcher executed under w3wp and reached the same temporary web cache path.，源地址 `10.60.1.14`
2026-05-11 14:21:00 UTC，资产 `web-app-01`，Credential-store access from the web worker account followed the PowerShell launcher.，源地址 `10.60.1.14`
2026-05-11 14:24:20 UTC，资产 `web-app-01`，关联对象 `10.60.2.34`，SMB connection from web-app-01 to app-db-01 followed the web-shell and PowerShell activity.，源地址 `10.60.1.14`
候选事件（尚未独立验证）：2026-05-11 14:27:00 UTC，资产 `app-db-01`，关联对象 `cdn-auth-check.net`，The database server resolved the same rare C2 domain after the SMB connection from web-app-01.，源地址 `10.60.2.34`
2026-05-11 14:31:30 UTC，资产 `app-db-01`，关联对象 `cdn-auth-check.net / 198.51.100.88`，app-db-01 contacted the original external infrastructure after the lateral movement signal.，源地址 `10.60.2.34`
2026-05-11 14:34:40 UTC，资产 `web-app-01`，关联对象 `10.60.2.34`，Remote service creation from web-app-01 to app-db-01 appeared after app-db-01 contacted the beacon infrastructure.，源地址 `10.60.1.14`

背景/替代解释事件：2026-05-11 14:42:00 UTC，资产 `web-app-03`，关联对象 `api-cdn-auth-check.net`，A second web server resolved a sibling domain on the same IP, but only as a single weak candidate signal.，源地址 `10.60.1.23`

背景/替代解释事件：2026-05-11 14:50:00 UTC，资产 `web-app-01`，A planned hotfix deployment started after the suspicious chain and may explain later service restarts.，源地址 `10.60.1.14`
